በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
በትረ: በትር — rod, staff (construct 'rod of') · also accusative 'rod(s)' after a number (ሠለስተ በትረ 'three rods')
ወነገሮሙ: ነገረ — and he told them (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them', G)
ወአምጽኡ: አምጽአ — and they brought (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of መጽአ) · and bring! (ወ- + 2mp imperative)
በበአብያተ: ቤት — by houses of, house by house (distributive በበ + plural አብያት, construct)
ለንጽሕ: ንጽሕ — purity (ለ- marking the object + noun)
ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
ተጽሕፈት: ተጽሕፈ — she/it was written (3fs perfect, passive tG-stem of ጸሐፈ)
ወበትረ: በትር — and rod of (ወ- + noun, construct) · and staff (ወ- + noun, accusative; ሕልቀተ ወበትረ 'ring and staff')
ተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — it was written (3ms perfect, passive of ጸሐፈ, ṣ-ḥ-f); also in the quotation 'it is written' (ተጽሕፈ በእንቲአየ)
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ወዕጸው: ዐጸወ — and shut! (ወ- + imperative 2ms, G, ʿ-ṣ-w)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
በቅድሜሆሙ: ቅድሜ — before them (በ- + noun ቅድሜ- + -ሆሙ '3mp them')
ለለ: ለለ — each, every (distributive); uncertain in this context (see note on ተረፈ) · certain as the distributive 'each' (ለለ አሐቲ ጊዜ 'each single time')
አስማቲሆሙ: ስም — their names (noun, plural አስማት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
ዘጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — what is written (ዘ- relative + passive participle ጽሑፍ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
ካህነ: ካህን — priest (noun, accusative, predicate after ይኩንከ)
ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53)
ወገብሩ: ገብረ — and they made, amounted to (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-r) · also 'and they did' (ወገብሩ ለነ ዘበሕጉ 'and they did for us what is by his law')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
አዘዞሙ: አዘዘ — he commanded them (3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
ጸብሐ: ጸብሐ — it dawned, became morning (3ms perfect, G, ṣ-b-ḥ)
ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
አእሩገ: አረጋዊ — elder, old man (plural አእሩግ (?); construct 'elders-of')
ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ቅድመ: ቅድመ — before (preposition, construct) · adverbial 'forward' (ቅድመ ወድኅረ 'forward and back')
ወጽጌ: ጽጌ — and blossom of (ወ- + noun, construct)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took')
ሠናየ: ሠናይ — good (accusative, adj. as noun) · adjective 'good, fine' agreeing with a noun (ልብሰ ሠናየ 'a fine garment')
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
በትር: በትር — staff, rod (noun); here a rod standing for a tribe
ዘኀረየ: ኀረየ — who chose (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, ḫ-r-y)
ኪያሁ: ኪያሁ — him, it (independent object pronoun, 3ms; base ኪያ- + -ሁ)
ወሰገዲ: ሰገደ — and they bowed down (ወ- + 3mp perfect, spelled ሰገዲ for ሰገዱ) (?)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will') · as object after ሰብሐ ('praise God', ይሴብሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
ወዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — and without (ወ- + preposition) · 'and before' + subjunctive (ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ 'and before she could nurse him')
ትስተይ: ሰትየ — that she drink (3fs subjunctive, G)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
ዘተወልደ: ተወልደ — who was born (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive/reflexive stem of ወለደ)
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice') · 'sound of' (construct: ቃለ ቀርን 'sound of the horn')
ወዘይቤ: ብህለ — and what he said (ወ- + ዘ- 'that which' + ይቤ 3ms perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
ትእምርተ: ትእምርት — sign, token (noun, fem., accusative) · construct 'sign of' (ትእምርተ ሕይወት 'sign of life')
ለማርያም: ማርያም — Mary (proper name); ለ- marks the object
እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ) · more than all (እምኵሉ with አፍቀረተኪ 'she loved you more than all')
ተዓይነ: ተዓይን — scouts, lookouts (?) (noun, construct 'scouts of'; sense from context) (?)
ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ነገሩ: ነገር — his speech, word, matter (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ህገረ: ሀገር — city, land (noun; construct 'land of'; spelled ህገረ)
ትዕይንተ: ትዕይንት — procession, train, array (noun; construct 'procession of') (?)
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
ዘይወፅእ: ወጽአ — who comes out (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ወርኵስ: ርኵስ — and uncleanness, impurity (ወ- + noun/adjective ርኩስ 'unclean')
እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world') · 'for ever' also after ካህኑ: 'his priest for ever', or 'priest of the world' (?)
ወበሰማያትኒ: ሰማይ — and in the heavens also (ወ- + በ- + plural ሰማያት + enclitic -ኒ)
ታንሶሱ: አንሶሰወ — she walks about (3fs imperfect, quadriliteral አንሶሰወ) · you walk about, you minister (2ms imperfect, ታንሶሱ ውስተ ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'you go about the house of God')
ጎሞር: ጎሞር — gomor, omer (Hebrew loan; a measure, here the golden urn of manna)
ክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the short form ክልኤ before a noun)
በአጽባዕተ: ጽባዕ — with the fingers of (በ- + plural አጽባዕት, construct)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ለማኅደረ: ማኅደር — for the dwelling of (ለ- 'for' + noun, construct)
ለሙሴ: ሙሴ — to Moses (ለ- + proper name) · ለ- marking the object after an anticipating suffix (ሐመይዎ ለሙሴ 'they slandered Moses') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (የውሃቶ ለሙሴ 'the meekness of Moses')
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ዘኢይነቅዝ: ነቀዘ — which does not rot (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative + 3ms imperfect, n-q-z 'be worm-eaten, decay')
ወትለብጦ: ለበጠ — and you shall overlay it (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, l-b-ṭ, + -ኦ 'it')
ጽሩይ: ጽሩይ — pure, refined (adjective, passive participle of ጸረየ)
ኵለንታሁ: ኵለንታ — all of him, his whole self (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ዘወረደ: ወረደ — which came down (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
እምሰማያት: ሰማይ — from the heavens (እም- + plural ሰማያት)
ሰማያተ: ሰማይ — heavens (plural ሰማያት, accusative; ዐርገ ሰማያተ 'he ascended the heavens')
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
ትተረጐም: ተርጐመ — she/it is interpreted (3fs imperfect, T stem passive; agrees with ባሕር)
ይተረጐም: ተርጐመ — it is interpreted (3ms imperfect ይተረጐም, passive/reflexive ተ-stem)
ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
ለክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — of Christ, Christ's (ለ- naming the possessor after an anticipating suffix) · ለ- marking the object, doubled by the suffix on ወያመስልዎ ('they liken Christ')
ወቃለ: ቃል — and the word of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word of')
ዘተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — which was written (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, ተ- passive of ጸሐፈ)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
